narr.Aqua Kyoto Paris: W35 users 5,387 with 352 GA4 bookings, both the highest of the last four weeks; conversion rate 6.5%. This is the first autumn week with a real year-ago reading: September 2025 sits after the GA4 property went live, so LY shows 5,433 users and 203 bookings. Users are flat on that base and GA4 bookings up 73%, but the LY traffic mix is not comparable: last year the same week ran 11,789 sessions off 5,433 users with 13% new users, against 6,817 sessions and 87% new users now. Google delivered 42 bookings at €28 CPA; Meta 49 at €30. Combined ad spend was €2,674, almost unchanged on €2,683, but the mix flipped: Meta recovered to €1,482 from €1,278 after the 1 October budget rise, while Google fell to €1,192 from €1,405 on a sharp taper over the last three days of September.

Aqua Kyoto Paris: GA4 went live late 2025, so the year-ago week is a real reading from September 2026 but the traffic mix behind it is still the launch period
